title: AI interview preparation web app
summary: Web app that prepares candidates for an interview from their CV and the job offer, through AI mock interviews.
highlights: Defined the scope and the technical stack, including a provider-agnostic language-model layer.
Designed GDPR and AI Act compliance of the product.
Designed a blind protocol to choose the language model (Mistral or Claude) on quality and cost.
